analysis.title: Walt Disney Co. (DIS): Orlando airport arrivals in August decrease 7% yoy
key_insights: Orlando International Airport (MCO) passenger deplanements fell 7% yoy in August 2026, after a 4% yoy decline in July. Domestic deplanements were down 7% yoy and international down 5% yoy.
Orange County Tourist Development Tax collections fell 3% yoy to $24.8 mn in August 2026, versus +6% yoy in July 2026.
Orange County hotel metrics softened in August: occupancy fell 5.8% yoy to 62.4%, room demand fell 5.7% yoy, and ADR fell 3.2% yoy to $174.95.
If current trends hold, C3Q26 MCO passenger deplanements would decline 6% yoy. GS still estimates Disney's F4Q26 domestic attendance at +1.5% yoy on an underlying basis (+9% reported).
Management said last quarter that international attendance headwinds at domestic parks persisted but moderated versus F2Q26, and that forward bookings at Walt Disney World remain healthy.

GS rates DIS Buy with a 12-month price target of $140 (25.2% upside from $111.83), based on a sum-of-the-parts valuation. The thesis rests on DTC profitability, studio improvement, sports rights cost mitigation and theme park growth backed by a $60bn 10-year investment.

market_movers.rationale: Buy and $140 target reiterated, with the target unchanged from 28-Sep-26. The airport and hotel data show softer Orlando demand, but GS keeps a +1.5% underlying F4Q26 domestic attendance estimate.

earnings_insights: GS forecasts DIS EPS (diluted, pre-exceptionals) of $7.03 for FY9/26E, $7.56 for FY9/27E and $8.61 for FY9/28E, versus $5.95 reported for FY9/25.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: $1.73 for 9/26E (F4Q26), $2.11 for 12/26E and $1.76 for 3/27E. $2.08 is the 6/26 figure.
GS estimates F4Q26 domestic attendance growth of +1.5% yoy on an underlying basis (+9% yoy reported).
GS FY9/26E revenue estimate is $101,828.7 mn (+7.8% yoy) and EBITDA estimate is $22,834.0 mn on the summary table ($21,154.3 mn in the income statement).
risk_factors: Economic slowdown weighing on consumer spending
Higher than expected interest rates and FX
charts_described: Exhibit 1 gives monthly Orange County TDT collections, with August 2026 at $24.8 mn and -3% yoy versus +6% in July 2026.
Exhibit 2 gives monthly MCO deplanements, with August 2026 total at 2,169 thousand and -7% yoy.
Exhibit 3 compares MCO deplanements yoy with DIS domestic attendance growth. C3Q26 MCO deplanements would decline 6% yoy versus GS estimate of +1.5% underlying DIS domestic attendance growth.

tension_points.bull_case: GS estimates Disney F4Q26 domestic attendance at +1.5% yoy underlying. Management said forward bookings at Walt Disney World remain healthy and international headwinds moderated versus F2Q26.
tension_points.bear_case: MCO deplanements fell 7% yoy in August and would be down 6% yoy for C3Q26 if trends hold. Orange County TDT fell 3% yoy and hotel occupancy fell 5.8% yoy.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Continued yoy declines in MCO arrivals and Orange County TDT collections in coming monthly updates would undercut the +1.5% underlying attendance estimate.
